name: Supporter Recognition - Import Step One The File
description: The bi-weekly spreadsheet as received, before anything has been matched: fourteen rows and four columns, with the padding and the blank cells left visible because those are the things a reader scanning the file does not catch. The state exists to establish what the file actually contains before the later steps argue about what it does not — there is no amount column, no founding column and no anonymity column, and that absence rather than any individual row is what decides the rest of the walkthrough.
